title: console: ?form=ID for a record that does not exist opens a blank editable "Edit" overlay instead of a not-found state, and the error appears only after Update
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZZ5q3itDsK1WDVLyQ

立卡门: ① 用户可见的体验缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: 界面，列表页带不存在的 `?form=` 打开，实测两次）
业务理由: 用户点到一个已被删除记录的旧链接（通知、书签、别人发来的地址），看到的是一张空白可编辑的「编辑」表单，会照着填完再点更新，直到提交才被告知记录不存在，白填一遍；同一个 id 走 `/forms` 路由会直接显示「无法打开记录（404）」，两处入口不一致。
动手的读者: 拥有 `ui/packages/app-shell`（全局表单浮层）的 ui 车道：浮层的编辑加载在记录读 404 时渲染与 `FormPage` 相同的未找到状态，不渲染可编辑表单。
查重: `form overlay nonexistent record blank edit form` 17 命中、`form= unknown id overlay 404 empty form` 100、`record form overlay not found empty edit` 320（含已关）；首页为 QA 运行记录与 record-page-v2 父单 #26676，无对应缺陷。
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-l2 — 10 cards from QA run #29151 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

QA-source: #29151 · platform-core.url-overlay-contract · observed beside the clauses

## What happens
On a stock showcase as admin, opening `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_category?form=NOPE_x` shows a dialog "Edit Category" with empty fields and an enabled Update button. The network shows `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_category/NOPE_x` 404 and `…/NOPE_x/field-access` 404. Filling Name and pressing Update sends `PATCH …/NOPE_x` → 404, and only then shows "Record NOPE_x not found in showcase_category". Nothing is written. The route form refuses the same id up front with "Could not open record … (404)".

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02), console built from the same tree; reproduced twice.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase, sign in as admin in the console.
2. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_category?form=NOPE_x`.
3. **Expected:** a not-found state with no editable form, as the `/forms` route shows.
4. **Actual:** a blank editable edit form; the 404 surfaces only after submit.

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)
The global overlay (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` reads `?form` ~:709 and mounts `ModalForm` ~:1586) renders the edit form whatever the record load answered. The route form (`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx:1904`) turns the same 404 into an error state. Landing: `ui/packages/app-shell` (or `ui/packages/plugin-form` if the edit-load path lives in ModalForm).
